title: Developer API
description: The public /v1 API on the shared engines: traffic, latency, streams and background jobs, capacity gates, output throughput, the usage ledger, node memory headroom, the engine wedge signature, speech to text and the upload rail. Panels on metrics that do not exist yet are marked [pending] or [proposed].

options.content:
**The public developer API (`/v1`) on the shared engines.** A panel title carries the status of the metric it reads: no marker = in Prometheus today, or created on first use (then the panel says what an empty panel means); **[pending]** = emitted by developer-platform code that is not merged or deployed yet; **[proposed]** = nothing emits it yet (the metric contract in `monitoring/developer-api/README.md` says exactly what to add). Pending and proposed panels say so instead of "no data".

**Engine panels count chat and API traffic together** — an engine cannot tell who sent a request. Public model → engine (`service` label): techsara-35b → `main` · techsara-8b-vision → `router` · techsara-ocr → `ocr` · techsara-embed → `embed` · techsara-rerank → `reranker` · techsara-whisper has no engine metrics (the bottom row: the orchestrator's `asr_*` count dictation and video, not /v1 calls). Alerts: `monitoring/prometheus/rules/developer-api.yml` — **no Alertmanager is configured, so no alert reaches anyone yet**; they show on Prometheus /alerts only.

panels.title: Requests / s [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. Every finished /v1 request, all routes and models.

panels.title: Failures, 10m [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. The WORST model's share of internal_error, timeout and model_unavailable outcomes (streams that failed after their 200 included; at-capacity refusals and model_recovering excluded), per model as PublicApi5xxRatioHigh counts them, so a busy healthy model cannot hide a broken quiet one.

panels.title: 503s, 1h [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. 503 model_unavailable "at capacity" answers, every engine.

panels.title: Open streams [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. Open /v1 SSE streams.

panels.title: Long output [pending]
panels.description: PENDING — the metric is emitted by developer-platform code that is not merged or deployed; this panel is empty until it is. Public techsara-35b work whose input plus planned output is above the long-admission threshold (131,072 tokens) — the multi-hour generations an orchestrator restart would fail. Until the engine-label fix in orchestrator/app/metrics.py this series is exported as engine="other" and reads nothing here.

panels.title: Admission queue
panels.description: Generations waiting for the main engine's admission lanes in the orchestrator, chat and /v1 together. Created on first use: the orchestrator publishes it only when a lane is used, so it is empty after a restart until the first generation. Never above 0 in the hours it existed (2026-09-12 to 09-13).

panels.title: Requests / s by route [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then.

panels.title: Requests / s by model [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then.

panels.title: Requests / s by status and error [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. status is the HTTP status sent; error is the terminal error code, so a stream that failed after its 200 shows as 200 with its error.

panels.title: Request duration p50 / p95 by route [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. Request received to last byte. A 1M-token answer is hours long by design; read p95 per route.

panels.title: Time to first token p50 / p95 by model [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. Request received to the first output token the caller can read, including admission and capacity-gate waits.

panels.title: Engine time to first token p50 / p95 (chat + API)
panels.description: Measured inside each engine: queue plus prefill. Orchestrator time before the engine is not in it.

panels.title: Engine end-to-end latency p50 / p95 (chat + API)
Streams in flight by route [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then.

panels.title: Background jobs by status [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. queued and in_progress are held now; completed, failed and cancelled are finished in the last hour. A restart fails every running job (retry-safe model_unavailable).

panels.title: Long-output generations (main.long gate) [pending]
panels.description: PENDING — the metric is emitted by developer-platform code that is not merged or deployed; this panel is empty until it is. One at a time by default. Anything running here is what a deploy of the orchestrator would cut off. Empty until the engine-label fix in orchestrator/app/metrics.py (README, known defect).

panels.title: Public gate in flight per engine [pending]
panels.description: PENDING — the metric is emitted by developer-platform code that is not merged or deployed; this panel is empty until it is. Public requests holding a shared engine's gate. Chat never passes through these gates. Until the engine-label fix every gate reads as one series named other.

panels.title: Public gate waiting per engine [pending]
panels.description: PENDING — the metric is emitted by developer-platform code that is not merged or deployed; this panel is empty until it is. Public requests queued for a gate. Sync and stream requests give up after the gate wait (30 s) with 503 + Retry-After; background jobs wait up to an hour by design, and the gauge cannot tell the two apart. Until the engine-label fix every gate reads as one series named other, last writer wins.

panels.title: At-capacity 503s / min per engine [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. engine=main is the admission lanes; the rest are the public gates.

panels.title: Admission lanes: active / waiting (main engine, chat + API)
panels.description: Created on first use: empty after an orchestrator restart until the first generation takes a lane.

defaults.noValue: no generation since the orchestrator started

panels.title: Admission rejections / min by reason
panels.description: Chat and /v1 together. The counter is registered on its first rejection, so an empty panel means none since the orchestrator started.

panels.title: Output tokens / s per engine (chat + API)
panels.description: Healthy single-stream decode on the main engine is ~100 tokens/s; whisper or OCR saturating a node pulls it toward 20-25.

panels.title: Public output tokens / s by model [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. Counted when a request settles, so a multi-hour generation lands as one step at its end; the engine panel beside it is the live rate.

panels.title: KV cache used per engine
panels.description: Above ~90% vLLM preempts. 14-day peaks before this release: main 59.5%, router 34%, embed 28%, ocr 25%.

panels.title: Preemptions per engine, 15m
panels.description: Zero on every engine in the 14 days before this release.

panels.title: Engine inference 5xx, 10m
panels.description: Share of each engine's INFERENCE answers that were 5xx, as EngineHttp5xxRatioHigh counts them: /v1/models, /health, /metrics, /ping, /version, /tokenize, /detokenize, /openapi.json and unmatched paths are left out of both sides, because those polls answer while inference is broken and outnumber it (main 70 polls to 10 completions per 10 minutes). The handler is in the engine's own series (http_requests_total{handler}).

panels.title: Ledger rows written / min (PostgreSQL statistics)
panels.description: The database's own table statistics. usage_events also carries chat usage. PostgreSQL counts attempted writes, including rows of transactions that rolled back, so this is write activity, not the ledger's outcome.

panels.title: Ledger writes by result / min [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. The application's view: usage.record and quotas.record_usage never raise, so a failed ledger write is otherwise only a debug log line.

panels.title: Memory available per node
panels.description: Lines at 4 GiB (NodeMemAvailableCritical) and 8 GiB (NodeMemAvailableLow). Unified memory: model weights and KV cache are in this number, and docker stats does not show them (use nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps). Lowest in 14 days: 3.08 GiB on the head, 2026-09-12 22:37Z, cause not established.

panels.title: Swap used per node
panels.description: Swap holds idle pages on these nodes all the time; the head sits near 23 GiB. What matters is growth while available memory is low (next panel).

panels.title: Swap growth over 15 minutes per node
panels.description: Line at 2 GiB. NodeSwapRisingUnderMemoryPressure fires only when this is above the line AND the node has under 16 GiB available.

panels.title: Requests running vs progress (main engine)
panels.description: Wedged: requests running while every progress line is flat. A ~950K-token prefill looks flat here too for ~14 minutes — the KV panel beside it is what tells them apart.

panels.title: KV usage changes over 3 minutes (main engine)
panels.description: 0 with requests running and the progress lines flat = VllmWedgeSignatureFromEngineCounters. Above 0 = the engine is still allocating KV (a long prefill is progress).

panels.title: Host packet filter table [pending]
panels.description: PENDING — the metric is emitted by developer-platform code that is not merged or deployed; this panel is empty until it is. 1 = the nftables table is loaded on that node, 0 = MISSING (the check ran and the table is not there), -1 = UNKNOWN (the check could not run, so the table's state is not known). Needs monitoring/exporters/host-guard/host_guard_textfile.sh installed and node-exporter's textfile collector enabled (README, host packet filter). nft needs root, so nothing else can see this.

panels.title: Speech to text (techsara-whisper replicas) and the upload rail
Speech queue and active transcriptions
panels.description: Dictation (asr.transcribe) and video clips (asr.transcribe_segments). Public /v1/audio/transcriptions calls do NOT pass through these counters, so this sees the whisper replicas through the chat app's own use; public whisper traffic is in the proposed public_api_requests_total{model="techsara-whisper"}. Created on first use: empty after an orchestrator restart until someone transcribes. KNOWN DEFECT (asr.py): the dictation and video pools write the SAME unlabelled gauges, last writer wins, so a video clip can hide a dictation queue. AsrQueueSustained fires on a queue held for 5 minutes (a dictation waiter gives up after 8 s).

defaults.noValue: no transcription since the orchestrator started

panels.title: Speech failures, 15m (dictation / video)
panels.description: Dictation (asr.transcribe) and video clips (asr.transcribe_segments). Public /v1/audio/transcriptions calls do NOT pass through these counters, so this sees the whisper replicas through the chat app's own use; public whisper traffic is in the proposed public_api_requests_total{model="techsara-whisper"}. Created on first use: empty after an orchestrator restart until someone transcribes. Share of attempts that failed, as AsrFailureRatioHigh counts them (over 20% with at least two failures).

defaults.noValue: no transcription since the orchestrator started

panels.title: Speech duration p50 / p95 / mean
panels.description: Dictation (asr.transcribe) and video clips (asr.transcribe_segments). Public /v1/audio/transcriptions calls do NOT pass through these counters, so this sees the whisper replicas through the chat app's own use; public whisper traffic is in the proposed public_api_requests_total{model="techsara-whisper"}. Created on first use: empty after an orchestrator restart until someone transcribes. Orchestrator wall clock for a successful transcription, queue wait included. whisper decodes one clip per replica. The orchestrator's default histogram buckets stop at 30 s, so a quantile at exactly 30 means 30 s or more; the mean line (sum / count) is not capped. Measured on production: over the hour to 2026-09-11 02:10Z video clips averaged 24.5 s, and in that window the 15-minute mean peaked at 3.7 minutes while the p95 line read 30.

defaults.noValue: no transcription since the orchestrator started

panels.title: Upload sessions open by state
panels.description: The chat app's chunked upload rail (documents, datasets, video), published on every /health call. UploadStuckFinalizing in alerts.yml fires on a session finalising for 15 minutes. The public /v1 Files and Uploads API has no code yet; its requests will be counted by the proposed public_api_requests_total{route="files"|"uploads"}.

panels.title: Upload bytes accepted / s by purpose
panels.description: Bytes the chunked upload rail accepted into parts. Created on the first part after an orchestrator start, so empty until someone uploads.

defaults.noValue: no upload since the orchestrator started

panels.title: Upload finalize p95 / mean by purpose
panels.description: From winning the finalisation to the stored result (concatenate, hash, extract). Created on the first completed upload after an orchestrator start. The default buckets stop at 30 s, so a p95 at exactly 30 means 30 s or more; the mean line is not capped.

defaults.noValue: no upload finished since the orchestrator started

panels.title: Upload sessions ended by result, 1h
panels.description: complete, rejected, cancelled or expired, per purpose. UploadSessionsExpiringInBursts in alerts.yml fires on more than 5 expiries in 15 minutes. Created on first use.

defaults.noValue: no upload ended since the orchestrator started

panels.title: Public files and uploads requests / s by status [proposed]
panels.description: PROPOSED — nothing emits this metric yet; monitoring/developer-api/README.md (metric contract) says what to add. This panel is empty until then. The public /v1 Files and Uploads API (chunked uploads for documents, images, audio and video) by HTTP status and error code.
